about: Hand-written meta descriptions for pages whose opening text has no whole sentence short enough to be one. Shaped { lessons: {topic: text}, notes: {topic: text}, units: {chapter: text}, titles: {topic: text} }; "titles" is a shorter topic name for the <title> of its lesson and notes pages when the full one would be cut. Never use the mark here: no "AP" in any meta description (docs/apstat-spec.md decision 2).

notes.ci-two-proportions: How to build and interpret a confidence interval for the difference between two population proportions, with the conditions to check and a worked example.
notes.sampling-dist-proportion: The sampling distribution of a sample proportion: its mean, its standard deviation, the 10% condition and the large counts condition for a normal shape.

titles.test-one-mean: Carrying Out a Test for a Mean
